actors.name: Karol Nawrocki
actors.blurb: Karol Nawrocki has been generating significant coverage in Poland due to his controversial proposals, including a referendum on EU climate policy and the formation of a New Constitution Council. His actions have sparked criticism from opposition parties and legal experts, particularly regarding the perceived bias of the referendum question and the inclusion of former Constitutional Court head Julia Przyłębska in the council. Nawrocki's defense of press freedom and his stance on U.S. military presence in Poland have also been notable.
